fields.name: ROW_ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Assigned code for the branch that onboards the customer (party).

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: CUSTOMER_ID
fields.description: Unique customer identifier as assigned to customers by the reporting institution.

fields.name: GENDER
fields.description: Customer's gender/sex with the possible options as {Male, Female, Corporate or Others}.

fields.name: CUSTOMER NAME
fields.description: Customer's Surname or registered company Name or Business/Trading Name.

fields.name: ONBOARDING DATE
fields.description: The date when the customer was onboraded in the format {YYYYMMDD} per ISO 8601.

fields.name: DATE OF BIRTH
fields.description: The customer's date of birth or registration in the format {YYYYMMDD} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: NATIONALITY
fields.description: Customer's Nationality based on the ISO country code of the customer (party)'s Nationality.

fields.name: PRI ID DOC TYPE
fields.description: Primary identification document used to open the account {Possible options include: National identity card, passport document, alien registration, service Id or company registraton certificate}.

fields.name: NATIONAL ID
fields.description: Unique identification number issued to Kenyans that are 18 years and above

fields.name: COMPANY REG NUMBER
fields.description: Unique registration certificate number assigned to registered corporates by the Registrar of Companies. Format to conform to the one for registrar of Companies in Kenya.

fields.name: PASSPORT NUMBER
fields.description: Unique passport Number

fields.name: PERSONAL ID NUMBER
fields.description: Personal Identification Number (PIN) as issued by Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA)

fields.name: CUSTOMER LEGAL STATUS
fields.description: The category for an individual, company or any other legal entity as provided by the law.

fields.name: CUSTOMER TYPE
fields.description: Whether the customer is an "Insider" or "External" to the reporting institution

fields.name: INSIDER CATEGORY TYPE
fields.description: E.g. {Directors, shareholders, employees and associates, etc}. Otherwise left blank

fields.name: ECONOMIC SECTOR CODE
fields.description: The sector code as per the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008.

fields.name: BUSINESS SEGMENT
fields.description: e.g. Corporate, Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Personal and Parastatal.

fields.name: RESIDENCY
fields.description: Resident (Kenya) or Non-resident (Rest of the world). ISO country code of the party's Nationality. {As per ISO-3166-1}.

fields.name: POSTAL ADDRESS
fields.description: Postal Address box number, Postal code, Town and ISO country code of the address location. {e.g. P.O. Box 123456, 00200-City Square, Nairobi, KE}.
fields.example: 132, My Street, Kingston, New York 12401, United States

fields.name: TELEPHONE NUMBER
fields.description: Mobile or Landline (CCC-AAA- XXXXXXX: CCC -Country Code, AAA - Area Code and XXXXXXX - Contact Number).

fields.name: EMAIL ADDRESS
fields.description: Customer (Party)'s email address
